repos_data.description: Lightweight Go SDK for Telegram Wallet Pay. Integrate crypto payments (TON, USDT, BTC, NOT) into Telegram bots effortlessly. Includes secure HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, middleware for net/http, Gin, and Echo. Zero dependencies for core client, typed error handling, and full test coverage. MIT licensed

Zero-dependency Go client for the Coinglass API v4. Typed access to Futures, Spot, Options, ETF, and Indicator endpoints, with context support, safe concurrency, automatic retry with exponential backoff on rate limits, sentinel errors, and functional-option configuration. Built on the standard library and fully tested.
Golang SDK for Dusupay payment gateway API (Unofficial)
Fasapay payment gateway XML API Client for Go (Unofficial)

⚡ Professional Golang SDK for Bybit V5 API. Lightning-fast trading with real-time WebSocket streams, complete REST API coverage, and production-ready features. Supports spot & derivatives trading, HMAC/RSA authentication, multi-region endpoints, and advanced order types with TP/SL. Goroutine-safe, testnet-ready, zero dependencies. 🚀

Idiomatic Go SDK for the Bitget Unified Trading Account (UTA) API v3. Lightweight, dependency-minimal client with context.Context, typed REST models, string-based prices/quantities to avoid float rounding, plus reconnecting WebSocket with auto-resubscription. Built for safe and reliable crypto trading automation.
Complete, dependency-free Go client for the YNAB API — 44 operations, exact integer money, first-class delta sync, contract-tested. Unofficial.
Go library for the crypto NOWPayments API
Simple and easy retry mechanism package for Go

Idiomatic Go SDK for KuCoin REST & WebSocket APIs — UTA (Unified Trading Account) and Classic (Spot, Margin, Futures). Hand-written, not generated. String-typed prices, HMAC-SHA256 auth, context-aware methods, typed error hierarchy, conservative retry policy, injectable HTTP client, and manifest-driven endpoint documentation.
Official Python client for the finlight.me financial news API
